notes.title: v 0.9.0.9 Progress Update
notes.content: v 0.9.0.9 will be delayed slightly, but will now include initial support for non VR first person play. ETA is now during august.

tags.feature: - will now include initial support for non VR first person play.

notes.title: v 0.9.0.8 Fishing/Taming
notes.content:
• added first iteration of animal taming
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131022/6ce2676cff58e9aa44de5367904c3b02707be65a.jpg[/img]
• added first iteration of fishing
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131022/fb70495d22a46e589d4dee0f95cbee1ebebee773.jpg[/img]

• increased backpack grabbable area
• moved toolbelt closer to the player
• WMR now uses thumbstick for locomotion instead of touchpad
• removed avatar and avatar + hands (just keeping the controller and hands options to better focus on comfortable belt position and backpack interaction)
• UI pointer fixes
• increased brightness during the night slightly
• fixed player rotation when placing furniture
• holding items should be more stable
• door now open when you swing it in a certain direction. should make opening it easier
• opening and closing the door can now also be done by touching the door and clicking the trigger



Next up:
Vegetation update and performance improvements, Multiple smaller islands to explore



as usual if there are any problems, please don't hesitate to let me know through any of the channels (discord.gg/TM9wgxW / facebook.com/Lucid-Pixel-170868577018414 / or the community hub)

notes.title: v 0.9.0.7 Sea Travel
notes.content:
• added a driveable boat
(it is craftable using the workbench)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131022/4944b28dba8edc0ac12d782695932ee849aa6a9b.jpg[/img]

• added wooden log buildings
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131022/aa379db8c948277d1dd2764a9c063c8e5916758a.jpg[/img]

• added stone buildings
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131022/8a4f0927438cd2ace5411b11c4de0f5b99ee0313.jpg[/img]

• added some basic interior furniture
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131022/761af0e0b6cb7309ddecee51dc07256707dcd971.jpg[/img]

• minor resource requirement changes



Next up: animal taming, fishing
